description: Deletes a dataset. Evals bound to it stop being runnable (their binding shows datasetOk: false), and reviews/specs over its items lose their source — check caliper_evals_list for evals that reference it and say so before proposing. May return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: caliper_datasets_delete
title: Delete a Caliper dataset
